davy-safety-lamp.research_focus: the Davy safety lamp's construction (wire-gauze cylinder around the flame) and early nineteenth-century English coal mines
davy-safety-lamp.scene: A miner crouches in a low coal seam holding up a lamp whose small flame burns inside a cylinder of fine wire mesh, the tunnel lit only by it

swiss-army-knife-introduced.research_focus: the 1891 Swiss Soldier's Knife: wooden handle scales, blade, screwdriver, can opener and reamer
swiss-army-knife-introduced.scene: A folding pocket knife with wooden handle scales lies on a soldier's wool tunic, its blade, can opener and screwdriver fanned half open; no modern plastic handle

electric-flashlight-ever-ready.research_focus: early Ever Ready tubular flashlights around 1899-1905 and gaslit city streets of that time
electric-flashlight-ever-ready.scene: A gloved hand holds a slim tubular metal torch whose beam cuts across a cobbled street at night

kodak-brownie-camera.research_focus: the original 1900 Kodak Brownie box camera and children's clothing around 1900
kodak-brownie-camera.scene: A child in a summer garden holds a small square box camera at waist height, looking down into it to frame a picture of a dog

thermos-vacuum-flask.research_focus: early twentieth-century Thermos vacuum flasks (metal case, cup lid) and Edwardian picnics
thermos-vacuum-flask.scene: A cylindrical metal vacuum flask with its cup-lid off stands on a picnic blanket, steam rising from the poured drink beside it

leica-i-camera.research_focus: the Leica I (Model A) 35mm camera of 1925, its collapsible lens and compact body, and 1920s city streets
leica-i-camera.scene: A small compact rangefinder camera with a short collapsible lens is raised to a photographer's eye on a busy 1920s city pavement

zippo-lighter-introduced.research_focus: the 1933 Zippo lighter: rectangular metal case, hinged lid, chimney with holes around the wick
zippo-lighter-introduced.scene: A rectangular metal lighter with its hinged lid flipped open holds a steady flame inside its perforated chimney, despite wind bending the grass behind it

handie-talkie-radio.research_focus: the SCR-536 Handie-Talkie: brick-shaped hand-held radio with a telescoping antenna, used by US infantry in the Second World War
handie-talkie-radio.scene: A helmeted infantryman crouched behind a hedgerow holds a brick-shaped hand-held radio to his face, its long thin antenna extended upward

kodak-instamatic-camera.research_focus: the 1963 Kodak Instamatic camera and its drop-in 126 film cartridge, and 1960s family holidays
kodak-instamatic-camera.scene: Hands drop a square plastic film cartridge into the open back of a small flat camera on a beach towel; a separate flash cube sits beside it

hp-35-pocket-calculator.research_focus: the 1972 HP-35 scientific calculator: its shape, key layout and LED display, and engineers' desks of the early 1970s
hp-35-pocket-calculator.scene: A slim hand-held calculator with rows of keys and a glowing display rests on an engineer's drafting table, a wooden slide rule pushed aside next to it

motorola-dynatac-8000x.research_focus: the Motorola DynaTAC 8000X: a large brick-shaped handset with a long rubber antenna and keypad, and 1980s offices
motorola-dynatac-8000x.scene: A large brick-shaped mobile phone with a stubby rubber antenna stands upright on a 1980s office desk beside a leather briefcase; no people

blackberry-email-device.research_focus: the 1999 BlackBerry 850 two-way pager: small screen above a thumb keyboard, holstered on a belt
blackberry-email-device.scene: A small hand-held device with a tiny screen over a full thumb keyboard sits in a belt holster on a business suit; no readable text on the screen

apple-ipad-introduced.research_focus: the first-generation iPad of 2010: thick bezel, single home button, aluminium back
apple-ipad-introduced.scene: A thin slab tablet with a wide bezel and a single round button lies on a sofa cushion beside a folded newspaper and a mug; no people, nothing legible on the screen

airpods-wireless-earbuds.research_focus: the first-generation AirPods of 2016 and their small flip-top charging case
airpods-wireless-earbuds.scene: A small rounded charging case with its lid flipped open holds two stemmed cordless earbuds, resting on a train seat; no people

samsung-galaxy-fold.research_focus: the 2019 Samsung Galaxy Fold: a book-style folding phone with an inner bendable screen and a small outer screen
samsung-galaxy-fold.scene: A phone opened like a small book reveals one continuous bendable screen across its fold, lying half open on a café table; no logos and nothing legible on screen

apple-airtag-tracker.research_focus: the 2021 AirTag: a small coin-shaped disc tracker on a key ring or bag strap
apple-airtag-tracker.scene: A small coin-shaped disc on a key ring hangs from a bunch of house keys left between sofa cushions, a phone screen nearby showing a map pin; no people
